messages:
Leah (CS): FYI — we're seeing a spike in embeddings indexing latency affecting a subset of onboarding tenants. I opened a bridge with eng.
Omar (CS): Which tenants are impacted? Any clear ETA on fix?
Jon (SRE): We're investigating a storage pressure pattern during parallel bulk-ingest jobs between 03:10–04:30 UTC. Root cause not confirmed yet.
Mika (Support): We've got 12 open tickets with customers reporting slow embedding writes / timeouts. Two are high-touch onboarding accounts.
Leah (CS): Priority: communicate proactively, offer remediation credits, and schedule an office hour for affected customers. Draft below — feedback?
Leah (CS): ```Hi <CustomerName>,
We’re writing to let you know we experienced intermittent delays during embedding indexing that may have slowed your onboarding. Our engineers are investigating and we’ve prioritized your account. We’ll follow up with an RCA and any credits we apply. If you’d like a walkthrough, we can schedule a live office hour. — Redwood CS```
Omar (CS): Good. Can we add an estimated timeline and link to a status page? Also mention mitigations we already did.
Jon (SRE): Mitigation timeline: 03:45 UTC — throttled parallel ingest; 04:05 UTC — surfaced KV cache hit tuning; 04:20 UTC — rolling fixes deployed to indexing workers; 04:28 UTC — observed latency back to baseline for most customers.
Priya (PM): Please include that we disabled one aggressive batch path while we validate performance — that reduces peak throughput but stabilizes latency.
Mika (Support): I'll queue templated replies for the 12 tickets with a note that high-touch customers will get a personalized outreach and offer of 1:1 office hours.
Leah (CS): Action items: Omar — send the above customer blurb (with timeline) to the 12 open tickets by EOD. Mika — schedule office hours slots and share calendar invites. Jon — finalize RCA draft and confirm which accounts saw token loss or duplicate writes. Priya — confirm credit/comp policy for affected onboarding quotas.
Omar (CS): Ack. I'll include a short FAQ in the reply addressing: will data be duplicated, are embeddings reindexed automatically, and how credits are applied.
Jon (SRE): Early RCA notes: race in ingress batching causing temporary queue backlog + S3 Throttling spikes on a specific partition. Working with storage infra to prevent recurrence. Full postmortem by tomorrow AM.
deploy-bot: Incident created — INC-20240315-1022 — severity P2. Bridge link: https://call.example/bridge/INC-20240315-1022
Priya (PM): For credits: propose applying a one-time onboarding throughput credit equivalent to 48 hours of normal ingest capacity for affected accounts, plus priority reindex quota. Approve?
Leah (CS): That seems fair for high-touch customers. For smaller trials, offer a 24-hour credit and free office hour invite.
Mika (Support): Draft FAQ snippet to include in replies:
```Q: Will my data be lost or duplicated?
A: No data loss expected. We detected transient write delays; where necessary we requeued writes. If any duplicates are found we will dedupe on our side and notify you.
Q: Will you re-run indexing?
A: We will reprocess any records that failed to index and will prioritize affected tenants.
Q: How do I get the credit?
A: CS will apply it to your account and confirm via this thread.```
Omar (CS): I'll send out replies now and add the office-hours link placeholder. Will ping when done.
Jon (SRE): Postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause (ingest batching + storage partition throttle), mitigations applied, long-term fixes (backpressure at ingress, storage partition balancing), and verification steps. I’ll upload draft to the incidents drive once ready.
Leah (CS): Good. After replies go out, let's capture customer feedback in a short survey link we include in the follow-up RCA. Priya — can product own the survey + KPI ask?
Priya (PM): Yes — I'll put together 3 quick questions (impact severity, satisfaction with response, request for bot contact) and host it on our internal survey.
Mika (Support): Sent templated replies to 12 tickets; flagged 2 for personalized outreach. Office hours slots created: 10:00 and 16:00 UTC tomorrow.
Omar (CS): Replies sent to customers, included timeline and FAQ, offered office hours. Two customers requested immediate 1:1 — Leah, do you want to handle those?
Leah (CS): I'll take them. Jon — please DM me the verification logs for those accounts so I can reassure them live.
Jon (SRE): Will do. Uploading logs now.
Leah (CS): Thanks everyone — keep this thread updated with RCA draft and final credits applied. I'll prepare an exec-summary for renewals if any accounts escalate. :thumbsup:
